prompt: Some cities have made all public transport free to use, paying for it through taxation instead of fares. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In recent years, some cities decided to make the public transport free for everybody, and the money comes from the taxes instead of the tickets. In my opinion, this is a positive development, although it also has some disadvantages.

The first reason why it is positive is that it helps the poor people. For a low income family, the bus tickets are a big expense every month, especially if they have to travel to work or school every day. If the transport is free, they can save this money and spend it for other important things like food or education. Also, the old people and the students can travel more easily, so they will not feel lonely at home.

Another reason is the environment. When the buses and trains are free, more people will leave their car at home and use the public transport instead. As a result, there will be less cars on the roads and the air pollution will reduce. This is very important nowadays because many cities are suffering with the dirty air.

On the other hand, there are some negative points. The government has to pay a lot of money for this system, so maybe they will increase the taxes, and the people who never use the bus also have to pay for it. Moreover, the buses can become too much crowded, because many people will use them even for a short distance. In the morning the buses are already full with workers and students, and if they are free, it will be worse.

In conclusion, I believe free public transport is a positive development because it helps the poor people and the environment. The government should find the money carefully so the service stays good.
title: Making public transport free
